posts.summary: Honors Graham's legacy, urges swift passage of Russia sanctions bill
posts.quote: Senator Lindsey Graham was a visionary, a courageous patriot, and a personal mentor and friend. We shared the same worldview: that the U.S. is strongest at home when we're strongest abroad. Congress can honor his life and legacy by swiftly passing his tough Russia sanctions bill.

posts.text: Lindsey Graham was a giant in the United States Senate. This is a loss not only for his family and friends like me, but for the entire nation. We shared a similar world view that America is strongest at home when we are strong abroad. We worked together on many foreign policy issues, including the Russian sanctions bill. I am introducing the House version of that bill this week, and Congress should pass it in his honor. Above all, Lindsey was a friend and I will miss him very much.

posts.text:
Since I founded the Childhood Cancer Caucus 17 years ago, advancements in technology have radically expanded the frontiers of healthcare. Today, I introduced the AI for Kids Act, which codifies and builds on @Potus’ EO to leverage cutting-edge tech to unlock cures for pediatric cancer patients. By empowering AI to continuously drive research forward, we move one step closer to eliminating cancer as a threat to children’s lives.

posts.text:
Every day our nation loses 17 veterans to suicide. We must do more to help these heroes heal from their invisible wounds.

Today, I spoke in support an NDAA amendment I've championed, led by @RepLuttrell, to expand veterans' access to neuroplastogen treatments like ibogaine.
posts.summary: Advocates expanding veterans' access to neuroplastogen treatments for suicide prevention
